_why: Backfilled from the link already committed as WoaSoloSpecLink.7.2.80;
re-encoding reproduces it byte for byte.
Buys the four Alonecraft restoration talents that give a healer damage and
a pet it otherwise has none of:
Nature's Guardian 5/5  every totem summons an elemental guardian.
Defence of Nature 2/2  (was Improved Reincarnation) shield procs become a
Focused Mind 3/3       the Cleared Mind loop.
Healing Grace 3/3      heal crit, which feeds Ancestral Awakening and so
Funded by the 13 points the premade build spends in Enhancement, plus the 2
it leaves unspent -- the premade resto link totals 69 of 71, which is a bug
in its own right and is tracked separately.
Totemic Focus stops at 2/5: it is totem mana cost, and the two points it
gives up are what pays for the tier-1 talents above.
